passage: Assessing the role of forests as sinks for airborne microplastics that would otherwise continue to disperse in the atmosphere, Akane Miyazaki and her team measured concentrations of plastic particulates on leaves from konara oak trees in Japan. The team used three separate extraction methods: an ultrapure water rinse, a rinse combined with ultrasonic waves, and an alkaline solution treatment that removes epicuticular wax (a surface coating on most land plants to which particles can adhere). The concentrations of particulates recovered were 7.6 percent for water extraction, 38.4 percent for ultrasonic extraction, and 53.8 percent for alkaline extraction, leading the team to conclude that previous assessments have likely underestimated forest canopies’ capacity as sinks.

explanation: 若以往研究多使用不会明显作用于蜡质层的方法，它们就会漏掉黏附在蜡质上的微粒，从而低估森林冠层的吸附能力。A 正好补上这一因果链，所以选 A。

passage: In an international collaboration, Elaine Ostrander, Alan K. Outram, and other researchers probed the evolutionary history of size variation in modern dogs. Scientific consensus held that early dogs had large body mass and that a genetic driver of smaller size in some breeds (e.g., bulldogs) developed only within the last 20,000 years as a result of selective breeding for characteristics favored by humans. Ostrander et al. assert that this explanation is flawed, having discovered that a mutation responsible for variants of IGF1, a gene found in many mammals that regulates production of insulin-like growth factor 1, is ubiquitous in domestic dog breeds.

Assuming a 15-year cell lifetime, the LCOE for plants using new cells was 4.99 cents per kilowatt-hour, whereas the LCOE for plants using cells recycled three times was 4.05 cents per kilowatt-hour. Furthermore, when the assumed cell lifetime was reduced by two-thirds, the LCOE difference increased from 18.8% to 31.3%.

passage: Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for large vortices, fish with intermediate heads would be better able than narrow- headed fish to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, intermediate-headed fish will be more likely than narrow-headed fish to detect obstructions that create large vortices.

passage: Rafael Núñez and colleagues studied how members of the Yupno, an Indigenous group in Papua New Guinea, conceptualize time. The researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases, such as abjuk, a present-oriented expression that translates to “now,” and coded each speaker’s manual gestures. Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions using spatial concepts and gestures, particularly along egocentric axes (i.e., relative to the orientation of the speaker): for instance, English speakers often refer to the front/back axis to describe events in time. In an anthropology paper, a student claims that the tendency toward ego-based conceptualizations of time is universal.

passage: Neurobiologists Laura Cuaya, Raúl Hernández-Pérez, and colleagues investigated the language detection abilities of eighteen dogs. The researchers monitored the brain activity of Bran (a border collie), Alma (a mixed breed), and other dogs while the animals listened to three recordings: one of The Little Prince being read in Spanish, the second in Hungarian, and a third made up of short, randomly selected fragments of the first two, scrambled so that they didn’t resemble human speech. Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues modeled seasonal changes in net CO₂ in Alaska in a landscape grid of 1 square kilometer (km²) cells and again in a grid of 10 km² cells, which are finer resolutions than most models of net CO₂ have achieved. The researchers concluded that variations in the landscape affect net CO₂ in ways that most models are too coarse to capture.

Examining chemical data from lithospheric and mantle-derived rocks ranging from 285 million to 3.8 billion years old, the researchers dated the transition to 3.2 billion years ago.

passage: Water flowing around an obstruction creates vortices (patterns of swirls) of varying size; by detecting the vortices, fish can determine the size and position of the obstruction. Testing by Yuzo R. Yanagisuru, Otar Akanyeti, and James C. Liao using models of three head shapes—narrow (low ratio of width to length), intermediate, and wide (high ratio of width to length)—showed that for medium-sized vortices, fish with wide heads would be least able to distinguish between vortices and general turbulence in the water. A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low-visibility conditions, wider-headed fish will be less likely than narrower-headed fish to detect obstructions.

While bioaccumulation of manufactured nanoparticles may be inherently worrisome, it has been hypothesized that Ag-NP bioaccumulation in invertebrates like E. fetida could serve a valuable proxy role, obviating the need for manufacturers to conduct costly and intrusive sampling of vertebrate species—such as black rats (Rattus rattus), commonly used in regulatory compliance testing—for nanoparticle bioaccumulation, as environmental protection laws currently require.

passage: Hypothesizing that lullabies, characterized by their slow tempos, are universally calming to infants, Constance M. Bainbridge and colleagues played a lullaby sung in the Western Nahuatl language and a non-lullaby sung in the Serbian language to a group of infants. The team found that the infants’ heart rates and pupil size both decreased more during the lullaby than during the non-lullaby. Since a decrease in heart rate is associated with relaxation, the team concluded that the lullaby relaxed the infants. However, noting that reduced heart rate can also be associated with increased attention, one critic argues that instead, the lullaby simply attracted the infants’ attention.

Mohamed Alburaki, Yanping Chen, and colleagues analyzed a large sample of honey bees (Apis mellifera L.) collected from most US states, assessing mitochondrial DNA markers to identify three maternal evolutionary lineages—North Mediterranean, West Mediterranean, and African—and the distinct haplotypes (inherited DNA variants) associated with each. The researchers identified 24 haplotypes in total; bees of the North Mediterranean lineage made up 87% of the sample and accounted for 18 of those haplotypes, while the West Mediterranean and African lineages made up 9% and 4% of the sample and accounted for 4 and 2 haplotypes respectively. Moreover, one North Mediterranean haplotype was recorded in 29 of the 30 states sampled, whereas each African haplotype was recorded in only two states.

Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes: for instance, Hebrew speakers often refer to the right/left axis to describe events in time. Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Núñez and colleagues claim this is not the case.

prompt: Which phrase from the text states the position that Núñez and colleagues’ claim is directed against?

options.text: “Previous research has found a tendency in many cultures to make temporal distinctions along imagined linear axes”
“Hebrew speakers often refer to the right/left axis to describe events in time”
“the researchers recorded Yupno speakers explaining certain temporal words and phrases”
“Some researchers believe this tendency is universal”

explanation: 前文指出线性时间轴出现在许多文化中，末句另提部分研究者据此主张普遍性。Núñez 等人质疑的是后一个、更强的主张。D 引用的正是普遍性断言。
clue: 末句 Some researchers believe this tendency is universal, but Núñez and colleagues claim this is not the case。
optionAnalysis: 只说许多文化存在这一倾向，未断言所有文化都如此。
希伯来语是一个实例，未主张普遍性。
描述研究记录的材料，属于方法。
明确宣称这种倾向普遍存在，正是 Núñez 等人反驳的立场。

passage: Psychologist Lisa K. Son and colleagues showed participants several series of images of an everyday object, each series progressing from blurry to clear, and asked participants to identify the object as soon as they were confident they could (on average, at image 12 of 15). Participants then returned to each series and were asked to recall the point at which they had been able to identify the image; on average, they selected image 10. That phenomenon—believing that one knew more in the past than one actually did—is known as hindsight bias. When participants were asked to estimate when a peer who had not taken part in the experiment would be able to identify the object, the average selection was again image 10. The researchers concluded that this estimate reflected the same bias the participants had shown about themselves rather than an accurate sense of how hard the task was.

prompt: Which finding, if true, would most seriously call into question the researchers' conclusion?

options.text: Participants who were told in advance how the series had been constructed gave the same estimate for a peer as participants who were not told.
Participants recalled their own point of identification as later than it actually was.
Participants who needed corrective lenses gave lower estimates for a peer than participants with normal vision gave.
A separate group of people who had never seen the series identified the objects, on average, at image 10.

explanation: 研究者的结论是「估计第 10 张反映的是偏差」。如果从未看过这些图像的独立人群实际也平均在第 10 张认出物体，那么第 10 张就是一个准确的难度估计，参与者的同伴判断在事实层面是对的，结论随之被推翻。A 只说明事先提示与否不影响判断，无法区分「准确」与「有偏差」；B 与实验结果方向相反（被试是把识别点记早了，不是记晚）；C 涉及视力差异，与这一估计是否为偏差没有直接关系。
clue: 研究者把对同伴的 image 10 预测归于事后偏差，而同伴实际何时认出物体尚未测量。

不同视力组估计有差异，不能直接验证哪种估计准确。
独立人群真实平均识别点恰为第 10 张，削弱了偏差解释。

passage: The onsets of growing seasons in Alaska have been shifting earlier, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of mooseberry (Viburnum edule) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2 generated by the activity of soil microorganisms). Hydrologist Yonghong Yi and her colleagues modeled seasonal changes in net CO2 in Alaska in a landscape grid of 1 square kilometer (km²) cells and again in a grid of 10 km² cells, which are finer resolutions than most models of net CO2 have achieved. The researchers concluded that variations in the landscape affect net CO2 in ways that most models are too coarse to capture.

"Future models of net CO2 in Alaska should be run for a longer series of years so that seasonal patterns can be compared."

clue: 末句的 landscape variations 与 most models are too coarse，需要联系前面 1 km² 和 10 km² 两种网格。

相同景观的结果随网格尺度而明显变化，具体说明粗模型可能漏掉的变化。

passage: Artificial intelligence (AI) technology is increasingly prevalent in online marketing, largely in the form of autonomous algorithms that make use of extensive collections of data about individuals’ behavior to generate highly personalized advertisements in real time. In a recent survey of college students’ attitudes toward AI marketing, researchers found that respondents expressed little concern about AI marketing technology in general but expressed a high degree of concern about the collection and use of personal data (be it their own or other people’s). Since machine learning on immense troves of such data is intrinsic to the functionality of AI marketing tools, this discrepancy suggests that respondents may be comfortable with AI marketing in principle without registering how thoroughly it depends on a practice they object to.

Text 1

Researchers Douglas J. Levey and F. Gary Stiles observed that many migratory neotropical landbirds eat fruit or nectar and live in forest edges or other open habitats with large shifts in temperature. The researchers hypothesized that these traits each independently contributed to the evolution of long-distance migration in many neotropical landbird species, supporting their hypothesis with data relating to Turdinae and other families of birds.

Text 2

Levey and Stiles's hypothesis does not account for an additional possible evolutionary precursor to long-distance migration. W. Alice Boyle and Courtney J. Conway analyzed data on Machetornis rixosa and 378 other species of neotropical landbirds. They found that solitary foragers are more likely to migrate than birds that forage in groups, concluding that group foraging is consistently and negatively associated with long-distance migration.
